Entries.SourceTerm: 他人住處我不住，他人行處我不行

Senses.PreferredTarget: Where others stay I do not stay; where others go I do not go
SearchAliases: where others stay i do not stay; where others go i do not go
Senses.Note: Baiyun's old verse says he neither dwells where others dwell nor goes where they go. Xueguan cites it when asking whether one can distinguish living from dying. Zixian says it loses an eye and answers by dwelling and walking with others. Yikui says even shared staying or going can bind the participants. Zhufeng places Baiyun beside Dahui's opposite version and offers his own verse. The line is a challenge to borrowed positions, not a rule to avoid people.

Senses.Explanation: The image is movement that drags through mud and trails water with it: cumbersome passage that does not come away clean. Chan records turn that messy, encumbered scene into an appraisal of sayings, answers, explanations, and conduct, but they can also reverse it against the apparently sheer thousand-fathom wall. In an early question-and-answer record, Luohan answers a request for ‘a phrase for people’ with ‘dragging through mud and trailing water’; when asked for its import, he says ‘no small amount of disorder’ (如何是為人一句？拖泥帶水；意旨如何？郎當不少). Zhanran is asked directly, ‘what is dragging through mud and trailing water?’ and answers ‘seven hands and eight feet’ (如何是拖泥帶水？七手八脚). Yuanwu says that ‘not mind, not buddha, not a thing’ has already dragged through mud and trailed water (不是心不是佛不是物。已拖泥帶水。), and in his case commentary says that speaking the word ‘buddha’ does so while speaking the word ‘Chan’ covers the face with shame (道箇佛字。拖泥帶水。道箇禪字。滿面慚惶。). Lingyin Yinwen reverses the expected opposition: in the place of dragging mud and trailing water, a thousand-fathom wall stands; in the place of the thousand-fathom wall, one trails water and drags mud (拖泥帶水處千仞壁立，千仞壁立處帶水拖泥). The base order is attested; the reversed form is attested.

Senses.Explanation: A concessive hinge that grants what has just been said and at once turns it. Huangbo Xiyun grants Linji's planting answer while counting the thirty blows already taken, Langye Huijue praises Baizhang's three secrets and withholds the tidal wave, Linji Yixuan concedes his lingering doubt about Deshan and asks whether his messenger still sees him, Tianyin Yuanxiu grants Ganfeng's closing order while calling it a bow drawn after the thief has gone, and Fojian Huiqin concedes Yangshan's advance and retreat while opening the question of the folded hands. Yuanwu Keqin credits the later worthies with one side of the truth body and not its upward affair, Weilin Daopei grants the closeness of Mazu's three answers and presses what Nanquan's words finally are, Miyun Yuanwu grants the hall's mood and warns against citing it wrongly, Dahui Zonggao grants that nothing is extra and declares that an affair still remains, and Yinyuan Longqi grants that the whole array knots on his whisk and names the one who laughs aloud.

Entries.SourceTerm: 雖然如是，也是臘月蓮花

Senses.PreferredTarget: Even so, it is still a lotus in the twelfth month
AlternateTargets: For all that, this is a lotus blooming in midwinter
Senses.Note: A monk brings Daling’s answer to Sushan’s question about what to pay the builder of Sushan’s memorial tower. Sushan bows toward Daling and praises him, then adds this qualified image: a lotus blooming in the twelfth month. The unusual season keeps his praise from being simple approval. Later teachers ask why Sushan both bowed and called the answer a winter lotus, and whether any of the proposed payments settles the matter.

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 一喝，直得三日耳聾。師曰：此公案，今古拈提者，多謂百丈脚跟尚未全穩，得馬祖一喝，方能了當。若如此，何異萬里望鄉關？百丈捲席時，祖云：汝深明昨日事，便是徹骨徹髓了也。所以雪竇拈云：大冶精金，應無變色。但百丈既是精金，馬祖一喝，入他耳弦也不得。當馬祖喝時，便合掩耳出去，云何又三日耳聾？既是三日耳聾，何故云應無變色？此一則公案，乃是臨濟肇始處，此處未明，又安問其他哉？須知轉身一路，千聖不傳，末後一句，古今難搆，諸人也須審細好。舉僧為疎山造壽塔畢，白山，山曰：將多少錢與匠人？曰：一切在和尚。山曰：為將三錢與匠人？為將兩錢與匠人？為將一錢與匠人？若道得，與吾親造塔來。僧無語。後僧舉似大嶺庵閑和尚，嶺曰：還有人道得麼？僧曰：未有人道得。嶺曰：汝歸與疎山道：若將三錢與匠人，和尚此生決定不得塔；若將兩錢與匠人，和尚與匠人共出一隻手；若將一錢與匠人，累他匠人眉鬚墮落。僧回，如教而說。山具威儀，望大嶺作禮，歎曰：將謂無人，大嶺有古佛放光，射到此間。雖然如是，也是臘月蓮花。大嶺後聞此語，曰：我恁麼道，早是龜毛長三尺。師曰：疎山恁麼垂語，陷阱不少。幸得大嶺放光，一一炤破。雖然要與疎山造塔，亦大遠在。諸人且道作麼生與匠人？舉：洞山解制云：秋初夏末，諸兄弟未免或東或西，直須向萬里無寸草處去。祇如萬里無寸草處作麼生去？良久，云：此事須如枯木上糝花，始與他合。師曰：洞山恁麼說話，正是瑞鳳不棲於凡木，金龍豈守於寒潭？轉功就位。轉位就功即不無，看來也祇似猢猻上樹，捨一取一，未為好手。且道作麼生是本分底去處？良久，云：釣船載到瀟湘岸，氣噎無聊問白鷗。舉：炤布衲一夕指半月問溥上座曰：那一半在甚麼處去也？溥曰：莫妄想。炤曰：失却一半也。眾共嘆美。師曰：諸人且道：溥上座過在甚麼處？炤布衲雖得便宜，也是壓良為賤；眾雖嘆美，也是噇酒糟漢。但溥欠箇後語耳，待他云：失却一半也。便合云：果妄想不少，管取炤布衲一場懡㦬去也。舉：石霜遷化，眾請堂中首座繼住持。九峯云：待某甲問過。若會先師意，如先師奉侍，問云：先師道：休去，歇去，一念萬年去，寒灰枯木去，古廟香爐去，一條白練去。且道明甚麼邊事？座云：明一色邊事。峯云：元來未會先師意在。座云：你不肯我那？但裝香來，香烟斷處脫去不得，即不會先師意。遂焚香，香烟未斷便坐脫。峯乃撫座背云

Senses.Explanation: Sushan bows toward Daling after hearing his answer, then calls it a lotus in the twelfth month. Wanru and Yun’e revisit the tower payment and question what remains unsettled after Daling speaks. Sanshan challenges the proposed payments; Tongtian asks why Sushan both bows and qualifies his praise; Yongjue says the tower is still far from finished.

Senses.Explanation: Though the old field lies idle, only after winning it once can you rest. The verse says innate ground still must be realized in practice. Selected current source uses: Baiyu Jingsi in J36nB359, Gulin Zhi in J38nB429, Dabo Qian in J40nB472, Zhufeng Huanmin in J40nB483. The complete wording is the entry unit. The field image does not make awakening a literal possession.

Senses.PreferredTarget: Although the old field lies idle, one only rests after winning it anew.
AlternateTargets: The old ground may be there all along, yet only a fresh victory brings rest.

Senses.Note: Pinjixiang quotes Longya Judun by name in a four-line verse and asks what its old field means before answering with the image of a deed to ground already held. Fushi, Shiyu, and Yunshan each put the pair to work in their own present talks. The wording holds the tension between an old field that is already there and the victory or attainment needed before one can rest.
